topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I can't shake the feeling of the walls closing in, ever since they told me about the transfer. I've poured my heart into this department, built relationships, learned the ins and outs. Now, I'm starting from scratch, in a place where everyone's an expert and I'm the newbie. I try to focus on the positives—new challenges, fresh opportunities. But the uncertainty looms large. What if I don’t fit in? What if I struggle to learn everything fast enough? I keep reminding myself to take it one day at a time, to reach out for help when I need it. It’s just... a lot.
